Elementor Pro (form webhooks possible) and Zoho Mail (Zoho CRM possible) are installed, but I found no evidence of either integration. data.case_for: I tried to refute the A and the main claims held. (1) The pay signal is real: I re-read the Meta Ad Library myself on 19 Oct 2026 and page 'Swagat Builders' has 3 active ads, all 'Started running on 18 Oct 2026', two of them click-to-WhatsApp (API.WHATSAPP.COM destination, 'Send WhatsApp message', 'Book a Site Visit'). That is paying for enquiries that land in WhatsApp. There was also an earlier Cilantra video ad from 6 Aug to 1 Sep 2026, so this is the second paid burst in 3 months. (2) The scout's RERA claim is now verified on the official GujRERA public list: Swagat Cordelia (promoter Swagat Infra), reg. no. ...RAA17450/121026/311233, approved 12-10-2026, end date 31-12-2033, so a 448-flat project was registered 7 days ago and can now be marketed. (3) Email route is real: info@swagatdevelopers.in is a mailto link on their own contact page, and the domain has a live Google mail MX record. (4) Not a chain or agency: private Surat developer since 2008 with several promoter entities on GujRERA (Swagat Corporation, Builders, Buildcon, Infra), 13 projects listed, Facebook page 8K followers. (5) No bot, CRM or live-chat vendor found: I downloaded all 13 JS chunks and found no third-party host except the Meta Pixel and a Cloudflare beacon; the contact form posts to their own /api/contact and /api/callback-request. No anti-AI stance. (6) The Facebook page phone (078740 82362) matches the website, so the number is theirs. Priority city, English-language marketing, evidence under 2 days old.
data.case_against: A holds on 'they pay for enquiries', NOT on 'they answer slowly', which is pure hypothesis. Weak points: (a) The ad burst is only 21 hours old and the Ad Library shows no spend amount, so it could be a short test or a boost run by an outside agency; the earlier run lasted about 26 days with one ad. (b) Cilantra has been registered since 23 Jun 2025 (16 months), so the ads sell remaining inventory, not a fresh launch; Cordelia itself has no brochure, RERA number or floor plans on its web page yet, so its launch date is not public. (c) A testimonial published on their own site praises 'quick response times', which is self-published and undated but is the opposite of a slow-reply story, so the first touch must not claim slowness. (d) The About page names a Head of Sales, a Head of Marketing and a content/marketing team lead, so an in-house team (and possibly a CRM or telecallers) probably exists; invisible from outside. (e) Click-to-WhatsApp ads can carry a Meta greeting or run on a WhatsApp Business API number, which would make the 'no instant reply' gap smaller than assumed; I cannot see which number the ads route to without opening the chat, which I must not do. (f) Only a generic info@ mailbox is published, no named person's email. (g) The scout's lead 'Swagat Group' (Ahmedabad) is a different company and is NOT this one: it runs a Kenyt.AI website chatbot and automated brochure forms, so it was wrongly bundled.
data.ability_to_pay: Good. Two projects marketed at the same time, a new 448-flat registration, a long delivery record and paid ads in two separate bursts in 2026. The ad budget itself is not visible, so 'good' rests on size and ad history, not on known spend.
